steps.python:
import builtins, numpy as np
t = app.actions.run('scene.terrain_info')
assert t == ${t0} and t['kind'] == 'bumps' and t['size'] == [8.0, 8.0] and abs(t['height'] - 0.08) < 1e-6, t
placement, h = builtins.tr_heights()
print('TERRAIN_BUMPS', placement, h.shape, float(h.min()), float(h.max()))
assert h.shape == (81, 81) and abs(h.min()) < 1e-6 and 0.05 < h.max() <= 0.08 + 1e-6, (h.shape, h.min(), h.max())

import builtins, numpy as np
placement, h = builtins.tr_heights()
print('TERRAIN_STAIRS', placement, float(h.max()), float(h[40, 40]))
assert abs(h[40, 40] - 0.6) < 1e-4 and abs(h[0, 0]) < 1e-6, (h[40, 40], h[0, 0])
builtins.tr_step(240)
import nuka
tf = np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.RIGID_BODY_TRANSFORM), np.float64).reshape(-1, 7)
ball = tf[np.argmax(tf[:, 2])]
print('TERRAIN_BALL', tf.tolist())
assert 0.6 < ball[2] < 1.0 and np.hypot(ball[0], ball[1]) < 0.5, ball

t = app.actions.run('scene.terrain_info')
assert t['kind'] == 'bumps' and t['size'] == [8.0, 8.0], t

t = app.actions.run('scene.terrain_info')
assert t['kind'] == 'stairs' and t['count'] == 3 and abs(t['rise'] - 0.2) < 1e-6, t

s = app.actions.run('solver.status')
assert abs(s['dt'] - 1.0 / 240.0) < 1e-7 and abs(app.dt - 1.0 / 240.0) < 1e-7, (s['dt'], app.dt)
r = app.actions.run('sim.dt')
assert abs(r['seconds'] - 1.0 / 240.0) < 1e-7, r

import builtins
assert abs(${dt}['seconds'] - 0.005) < 1e-7 and abs(${dt}['rate_hz'] - 200.0) < 1e-3, ${dt}
assert abs(app.actions.run('solver.status')['dt'] - 0.005) < 1e-7 and abs(app.dt - 0.005) < 1e-7
t0 = app.actions.run('timeline.status')
builtins.tr_step(20)
t1 = app.actions.run('timeline.status')
labels = [b['label'] for b in app.document()['branches']]
print('TERRAIN_DT', t0['tick'], t1['tick'], labels)
assert t1['tick'] == t0['tick'] + 20 and '5 ms step' in labels, (t0['tick'], t1['tick'], labels)
t = app.actions.run('scene.terrain_info')
assert t['kind'] == 'stairs', t

t = app.actions.run('scene.terrain_info')
assert t['kind'] == 'stairs' and t['size'] == [8.0, 8.0] and t['count'] == 3 and abs(t['platform'] - 2.0) < 1e-6, t

d = ${d1}
assert d['kind'] == 'mixed' and d['seed'] == 3 and abs(d['tile'] - 5.0) < 1e-6, d
assert app.actions.run('scene.terrain_info') is None and app.world.terrain() is None
